text: 4j left one open line: *"the 72 `interpreted` are … compiled-ineligible by design (component tags, macros), not a defect"*. That was an assertion I had not measured, and the trigger list made it worth checking — `{ikb_}` is the project's **primary entity-view rendering engine**, so "ineligible by design" would mean the most-used pages in the app never touch the compiled path.
